# T57

> T57 is an AI-native digital trade platform for food. Started in Madinah, Saudi Arabia, it puts verified farmers, processors, traders, buyers, banks and logistics firms on one trade record, from quote to payment. T57 does not lend, hold funds or own goods; finance, escrow and insurance come through licensed partners.

## Facts

- A Saudi initiative: started in Madinah, headquarters moving to Riyadh. A global SaaS platform, piloting in five founding markets: Saudi Arabia, UAE, India, Malaysia and Türkiye.
- Founder and Chairman: Afzal Hussain Mohammed Nakheeb.
- A members-only verified trade club: every member passes KYC/KYB and is labeled by role; every trade runs on one tamper-evident trade record.
- Works with the Islamic Organization for Food Security (IOFS), an OIC institution, under a 10-year memorandum of understanding signed in June 2023.
- More than 150 non-binding MoUs and letters of intent from companies in 67 countries, 120 of them signed at Gulfood 2026.
- Five industries on one trade record: agriculture and food production, trade, logistics, finance and technology.
- Contact: hello@t57.ai, +966 56 971 22 22.

## Pricing

- Membership plans, per month: Explore $199, Core $499, Growth $749, Enterprise from $1,499. Annual: Explore $1,990, Core $4,990, Growth $7,490, Enterprise custom.
- Trade fee, charged to each side of a completed trade: Explore 0.75%, Core 0.60%, Growth 0.40%, Enterprise 0.20%. No fee to list products or send quotes.
- Founding members get 90 days free at launch. Partner services (finance, escrow, insurance, inspection, logistics) are quoted by the licensed partner and shown before you accept.
- Full details: https://www.t57.ai/pricing/plans

## How to join

- Apply online from any country; T57 verifies the business (KYC/KYB) and labels it by role, such as farmer, processor, trader, buyer, financier or logistics provider.
- Once verified, members post or answer requests, agree contracts and run each trade on one record from quote to payment.
- Governments and banks can request a briefing with the public-sector or finance partnerships team.

## Who we serve

- [Who We Serve](https://www.t57.ai/who-we-serve): T57 exists to connect everyone who grows, makes, buys, finances and regulates food on one trusted record.
- [Governments and Regulators](https://www.t57.ai/who-we-serve/governments): Live trade data, early warnings and clean tenders for ministries and agencies.
- [Banks and Financiers](https://www.t57.ai/who-we-serve/financiers): Verified borrowers, documents and shipment milestones on one record. You lend; T57 never does.
- [Sellers and Exporters](https://www.t57.ai/who-we-serve/sellers): Verified buyers send you requests, and partner escrow releases payment as each milestone is met.
- [Traders and Aggregators](https://www.t57.ai/who-we-serve/traders): Back-to-back contracts with verified parties, and licensed lenders compete to finance each trade.
- [Buyers and Importers](https://www.t57.ai/who-we-serve/buyers): Send one request, compare verified quotes side by side, and pay through partner escrow when terms are met.
- [Retail, HoReCa and Enterprise Buyers](https://www.t57.ai/who-we-serve/enterprises): Verified suppliers, approvals, and every contract, shipment and payment on one record your auditors can check.
- [Food Processors](https://www.t57.ai/who-we-serve/food-processors): Contract raw materials from verified farms and mills, checked for quality before they ship.
- [Cooperatives and FPOs](https://www.t57.ai/who-we-serve/cooperatives): Pool member volumes, win bigger buyers and tenders, and pay every farmer faster.
- [Partners and Collaborators](https://www.t57.ai/who-we-serve/collaborators): Institutions reach verified farmers, SMEs and traders, and measure results trade by trade.
- [Service Providers](https://www.t57.ai/who-we-serve/service-providers): Inspection, freight, customs and certification jobs come straight from verified trades.
- [Farmers and Producers](https://www.t57.ai/who-we-serve/farmers): Join through your FPO or co-op. See today's price, meet checked buyers and get paid on delivery.

## Why T57

- [Why T57](https://www.t57.ai/why-t57): Join, discover, finance, settle and close every trade on one AI-native platform, so every actor from farm to fork can see, trust and finance each transaction.

- [RFQ Bidding](https://www.t57.ai/why-t57/rfq-bidding): Get comparable quotes from verified suppliers, and turn the best one into a contract.
- [Virtual Trade Desk](https://www.t57.ai/why-t57/virtual-trade-desk): A full trade desk for every member, with AI doing the groundwork and people deciding.
- [Market & Price Intelligence](https://www.t57.ai/why-t57/market-intelligence): See prices, supply and risk by origin before you quote, buy or plan.
- [Trade Finance](https://www.t57.ai/why-t57/trade-finance): One verified deal file, several lenders competing to fund your food trade.
- [Digital Asset-Based Funding](https://www.t57.ai/why-t57/nft-funding): Turn verified trade documents into digital assets that funders can trust and finance.
- [eLC in Hours, Not Weeks](https://www.t57.ai/why-t57/elc-15-minutes): Electronic letters of credit, issued within hours once your application is approved.
- [Escrow Payments](https://www.t57.ai/why-t57/escrow-payments): Your money moves only when the goods do, with escrow released at agreed milestones.
- [Alternative Payments](https://www.t57.ai/why-t57/alternative-payments): Settle food trades in stablecoins, digital assets or bullion-backed payments, where the law allows.
- [Digital Bank](https://www.t57.ai/why-t57/digital-bank): Hold, pay and settle in any currency, near-instantly, inside your food trade.
- [Document Management & Audit Trail](https://www.t57.ai/why-t57/document-audit-trail): Every document, approval and milestone of a trade, on one tamper-evident record.
