## Common questions

- [What is T57?](https://www.t57.ai/): T57 is AI-native digital trade infrastructure for the food industry. It brings verification, quotes, contracts, finance access, insurance, inspection and logistics onto one trade record for verified members.
- [Who can join T57?](https://www.t57.ai/): Any business in the food chain can apply, including farmers, fishers, processors, manufacturers, brands, traders, importers, wholesalers, supermarkets and HoReCa buyers. Every member is verified before trading.
- [Does T57 lend money or hold my funds?](https://www.t57.ai/): No. T57 does not lend, hold client funds, own goods or provide transport. Finance, escrow, insurance and logistics are provided by licensed partners through the platform.
- [Which countries does T57 cover?](https://www.t57.ai/): T57's founding markets are Saudi Arabia, the UAE, India, Malaysia and Türkiye. Businesses in other countries can apply for membership online.
- [How does T57 use AI?](https://www.t57.ai/): AI helps with matching, risk checks, document preparation and forecasting. People make the final decisions, and any adverse decision is reviewed by a person.
- [Why does T57 verify every member?](https://www.t57.ai/who-we-serve): Verification lets every member trade with confidence. It also gives lenders and insurers the trusted information they need to support a trade.
- [Can individuals join T57?](https://www.t57.ai/who-we-serve): T57 is built for registered businesses and institutions. Individual farmers can join through a cooperative or producer organization.
- [How is T57 different from other food trade platforms?](https://www.t57.ai/why-t57): T57 is an AI-native ecosystem, working with IOFS and ASEAN, that brings trade, finance, logistics and policy-grade data together on one verified platform.
- [Why do the IOFS and ASEAN partnerships matter to me as a trader?](https://www.t57.ai/why-t57): They translate into faster onboarding, clearer rules of origin and better access to tenders and sovereign buyers, because T57 aligns with the institutions that set food security and trade priorities.
- [Does T57 only serve governments and institutions?](https://www.t57.ai/why-t57): No. The same rails that serve ministries and multilaterals also serve farmers, cooperatives, SMEs and enterprises, giving every player, big and small, access to verified markets and trusted counterparties.
- [How does the T57 trust score help farmers and producers, cooperatives, and FPOs reduce risk?](https://www.t57.ai/why-t57/club-membership): The trust score helps these groups assess whether prospective buyers, aggregators, processors, or service partners have the legitimacy, financial stability, trade history, and relationship strength needed to support dependable transactions. This reduces the risk of engaging with weak or opaque counterparties.
- [Why is the T57 ID useful for financiers and investors, partners, collaborators, governments, and regulators?](https://www.t57.ai/why-t57/club-membership): The T57 ID provides these stakeholders with a structured view of whether an organization has been verified across key trust factors, including compliance, field validation, references, and ecosystem reputation. That makes it easier to evaluate risk and engage with businesses whose credentials are supported by a more advanced process than standard marketplace profiles or basic business identifiers.
- [Who can respond to an RFQ on T57?](https://www.t57.ai/why-t57/rfq-bidding): Only verified members whose products, capacity and markets match the request. Buyers can also invite specific suppliers.
- [Can sellers see each other's bids?](https://www.t57.ai/why-t57/rfq-bidding): No. Each bid is visible only to the buyer, which keeps pricing fair and confidential.
- [Is the Virtual Trade Desk a person or software?](https://www.t57.ai/why-t57/virtual-trade-desk): Both. The Trade Desk is software that matches, prices, drafts and screens, supported by T57's trade desk team for cases that need human review.
- [Does the Trade Desk negotiate for me?](https://www.t57.ai/why-t57/virtual-trade-desk): No. It gives you matches, price data and checks. You negotiate and decide.
- [Where does T57's price data come from?](https://www.t57.ai/why-t57/market-intelligence): From public market sources and anonymized, aggregated trade data on T57. No individual member's prices are shared.
- [Can I use the data without trading on T57?](https://www.t57.ai/why-t57/market-intelligence): Market intelligence is part of T57 membership and is built to support trading on the platform.
- [Does T57 provide the finance?](https://www.t57.ai/why-t57/trade-finance): No. T57 does not lend or hold client funds. It sends your verified deal file to licensed lenders, who decide whether to fund the trade and on what terms.
- [What kinds of finance can I request?](https://www.t57.ai/why-t57/trade-finance): Pre-shipment and post-shipment finance, receivables finance and letters of credit, through participating banks and finance companies, including Shariah-compliant options.
- [Is this cryptocurrency?](https://www.t57.ai/why-t57/nft-funding): No. A tokenized trade document is a digital record of a real asset, such as an invoice or warehouse receipt. It is not a currency.
- [Which documents can be tokenized?](https://www.t57.ai/why-t57/nft-funding): Trade documents on a verified T57 trade record, such as invoices, warehouse receipts and bills of lading, where local law recognizes electronic trade documents.
- [What does "hours, not weeks" mean?](https://www.t57.ai/why-t57/elc-15-minutes): It is the target time for a partner bank to issue the electronic LC after your application has been approved. Approval itself follows the bank's own credit process.
- [Does T57 issue letters of credit?](https://www.t57.ai/why-t57/elc-15-minutes): No. Letters of credit are issued by licensed partner banks. T57 prepares the application from your trade record and connects you to them.
- [Who holds the money in escrow?](https://www.t57.ai/why-t57/escrow-payments): A licensed escrow partner. T57 does not hold client funds.
- [What happens if there is a dispute?](https://www.t57.ai/why-t57/escrow-payments): Release pauses automatically, and the dispute is handled under the contract and the partner's rules. Release resumes once it is resolved.
- [Are alternative payments available in every country?](https://www.t57.ai/why-t57/alternative-payments): No. They are offered only where local law allows, through regulated partners. Members in other countries settle through banks, escrow or letters of credit.
- [Does T57 hold my crypto or gold?](https://www.t57.ai/why-t57/alternative-payments): No. Custody, conversion and settlement are handled by licensed partners. T57 records the payment on the trade record.
- [Is T57 a bank?](https://www.t57.ai/why-t57/digital-bank): No. Digital banking services on T57 are provided by licensed partners. T57 connects them to your verified profile and trade record.
- [Which currencies can I hold?](https://www.t57.ai/why-t57/digital-bank): Any currency your trade needs. T57's banking partners hold, convert and settle across currencies, so you can pay suppliers and get paid by buyers in their own currency.
- [Who can see my trade documents?](https://www.t57.ai/why-t57/document-audit-trail): Only the parties you authorize for that trade, such as your counterparty, lender, insurer or inspector. Access is recorded in the audit trail.
- [Are documents stored on the blockchain?](https://www.t57.ai/why-t57/document-audit-trail): No. Documents are stored securely, and a digital fingerprint of each key record is anchored on the ledger. This proves the document has not changed without exposing its contents.
- [Do I have to use every capability on every trade?](https://www.t57.ai/capabilities): No. Members choose the capabilities each trade needs. Because they share one record, adding a service later does not mean starting again.
- [Who provides finance, payments and insurance?](https://www.t57.ai/capabilities): Licensed partners. T57 does not lend, hold client funds, own goods or provide transport. It provides the verification, workflow and trade record that connect these services.
- [Can I use T57 for domestic trade as well as exports?](https://www.t57.ai/capabilities): Yes. T57 supports domestic wholesale to supermarkets, HoReCa and institutions, as well as cross-border trade. See domestic B2B trade .
- [Can I use Trade Execution without finance or logistics?](https://www.t57.ai/capabilities/trade): Yes. You can use RFQs, contracts and traceability on their own, and add finance, insurance or logistics to any trade later.
- [Does T57 sell or buy the goods?](https://www.t57.ai/capabilities/trade): No. T57 does not own goods. Members trade directly with each other on T57.
- [Which products can I trade?](https://www.t57.ai/capabilities/trade): Food across the whole chain: grown, raised and caught products, and processed, manufactured and branded goods.
- [How long does an RFQ stay open?](https://www.t57.ai/capabilities/trade/rfq): The buyer sets the deadline. Bids received after it closes are not shown unless the buyer reopens the RFQ.
- [Can I negotiate after receiving bids?](https://www.t57.ai/capabilities/trade/rfq): Yes. You can ask clarifying questions or request a revised bid from any supplier before you award the contract.
- [Can sellers create offers without an RFQ?](https://www.t57.ai/capabilities/trade/rfq): Yes. Verified sellers can publish product listings and wholesale terms that buyers can respond to directly.
- [Is the Trade Desk included in membership?](https://www.t57.ai/capabilities/trade/virtual-trade-desk): Yes. Every verified member can use the Trade Desk. Higher membership tiers include deeper data and higher usage.
- [Does the Trade Desk make decisions for me?](https://www.t57.ai/capabilities/trade/virtual-trade-desk): No. It provides suggestions, drafts and checks. You make every commercial decision.
- [What happens when the Trade Desk flags a problem?](https://www.t57.ai/capabilities/trade/virtual-trade-desk): You see the issue and a suggested fix. If the issue concerns compliance or verification, it goes to T57's team for human review.
- [Can individual smallholders use contract farming on T57?](https://www.t57.ai/capabilities/trade/contract-farming): Yes, usually through a cooperative or producer organization that holds the T57 membership and signs on behalf of its members.
- [What happens if prices change during the season?](https://www.t57.ai/capabilities/trade/contract-farming): It depends on the contract. Fixed-price, minimum-price and formula-based agreements each handle price movements differently, and the terms are agreed upfront.
- [Does T57 provide the inputs or finance?](https://www.t57.ai/capabilities/trade/contract-farming): No. Inputs come from buyers or partners, and finance comes from licensed lenders. T57 provides the contract, records and workflow.
- [Does T57 submit bids on my behalf?](https://www.t57.ai/capabilities/trade/government-tenders): No. T57 helps you find, understand and prepare a response. You submit it through the issuing authority's official channel.
- [Can government buyers use T57 to run tenders?](https://www.t57.ai/capabilities/trade/government-tenders): Government buyers can invite verified T57 members to bid and track delivery on T57, alongside their own procurement rules and systems.
- [Which countries' tenders are covered?](https://www.t57.ai/capabilities/trade/government-tenders): Tenders from T57's founding markets first (Saudi Arabia, the UAE, India, Malaysia and Türkiye), with more markets added over time.
- [Who adds information to a lot's record?](https://www.t57.ai/capabilities/trade/traceability): The parties who handle it, such as the producer, processor, inspector and logistics partner, each add the events they are responsible for.
- [Can consumers see traceability information?](https://www.t57.ai/capabilities/trade/traceability): Yes, if the brand or seller chooses to share it through a link or QR code. Commercial details stay private.
- [Does traceability on T57 replace certification?](https://www.t57.ai/capabilities/trade/traceability): No. Certificates are still issued by accredited bodies. T57 links them to the lots they cover and makes them easy to check.
- [Do I need to install anything?](https://www.t57.ai/capabilities/trade/whatsapp-orders): No. Verified members can order through WhatsApp or T57 chat once their account is linked.
- [What if the AI gets my order wrong?](https://www.t57.ai/capabilities/trade/whatsapp-orders): You always see a summary before confirming, so you can correct it. Nothing is sent to the supplier until you confirm.
- [Is my WhatsApp conversation stored?](https://www.t57.ai/capabilities/trade/whatsapp-orders): Only the order details you confirm are recorded on the trade record, under T57's privacy policy.
- [Which payment option should I choose?](https://www.t57.ai/capabilities/finance/trust-payments): Escrow suits most new relationships and domestic wholesale. eLCs suit larger cross-border trades where a bank guarantee is expected. Wallet payments suit trusted, repeat relationships.
- [Can I combine payment options?](https://www.t57.ai/capabilities/finance/trust-payments): Yes. For example, a deposit can be paid into escrow and the balance under an LC, all on the same trade record.
- [Who resolves payment disputes?](https://www.t57.ai/capabilities/finance/trust-payments): Disputes are handled under the contract and the licensed partner's rules. Release pauses automatically until they are resolved.
- [Who holds the money?](https://www.t57.ai/capabilities/finance/escrow): A licensed escrow partner, in an account separate from T57 and from both trading parties.
- [What does escrow cost?](https://www.t57.ai/capabilities/finance/escrow): Escrow fees are set by the partner and shown before you agree the contract.
- [Can escrow be used with a letter of credit or trade finance?](https://www.t57.ai/capabilities/finance/escrow): Yes. Escrow can sit alongside an LC or repay a trade finance lender at settlement, on the same trade record.
- [Is the T57 wallet a bank account?](https://www.t57.ai/capabilities/finance/digital-wallet): It is an e-money or payment account provided by a licensed partner. For full banking services, see Digital Banking.
- [Can I pay people who are not on T57?](https://www.t57.ai/capabilities/finance/digital-wallet): Yes. You can pay external suppliers and service providers by bank transfer from your wallet, subject to the partner's checks.
- [What are the fees?](https://www.t57.ai/capabilities/finance/digital-wallet): Fees and exchange rates are set by the payment partner and shown before you confirm each payment.
- [What does "within hours" mean?](https://www.t57.ai/capabilities/finance/elc): It is the target time for issuance after the bank has approved your application. Approval follows the bank's normal credit process.
- [Can my own bank issue the LC on T57?](https://www.t57.ai/capabilities/finance/elc): If your bank is a T57 partner, yes. If not, T57 can connect you to participating banks.
- [Are electronic LCs legally valid?](https://www.t57.ai/capabilities/finance/elc): Letters of credit are commonly issued and advised electronically between banks. Electronic presentation of trade documents depends on local law, and T57 supports paper presentation where it is still required.
- [Can I keep my existing bank?](https://www.t57.ai/capabilities/finance/banking): Yes. You can keep using your own bank and connect it to T57, or use T57's partners alongside it.
- [Are digital-asset services available everywhere?](https://www.t57.ai/capabilities/finance/banking): No. They are offered only where the law allows, through regulated partners.
- [Who provides the bank account?](https://www.t57.ai/capabilities/finance/digital-bank): A licensed banking partner in your market, under its own terms and regulation.
- [Do I have to move my existing banking?](https://www.t57.ai/capabilities/finance/digital-bank): No. You can use T57's banking partners alongside your current bank.
- [Which countries are covered?](https://www.t57.ai/capabilities/finance/digital-bank): T57's founding markets first (Saudi Arabia, the UAE, India, Malaysia and Türkiye), with more added as partners join.
- [Which currencies can I hold and send?](https://www.t57.ai/capabilities/finance/multi-currency): Any currency your trade needs, through T57's banking and payment partners.
- [How long do transfers take?](https://www.t57.ai/capabilities/finance/multi-currency): Payments between T57 members settle in near real time. External transfers depend on the destination and partner network, and the expected time is shown before you confirm.
- [Can I send personal remittances?](https://www.t57.ai/capabilities/finance/multi-currency): Where partners offer it, verified business members can send remittances for staff. T57 is built for business payments, not personal accounts.
- [Is digital-asset settlement legal in my country?](https://www.t57.ai/capabilities/finance/crypto-banking): T57 shows digital-asset options only where they are permitted for both parties under local rules, through licensed partners.
- [What about price volatility?](https://www.t57.ai/capabilities/finance/crypto-banking): Stablecoins and gold-backed tokens are designed to reduce volatility, and partners can convert to local currency at the point of payment.
- [Are digital-asset payments Shariah-compliant?](https://www.t57.ai/capabilities/finance/crypto-banking): Views differ among scholars. Members who need Shariah-compliant settlement should seek guidance and can choose gold-backed tokens or conventional options instead.
- [Who provides the finance?](https://www.t57.ai/capabilities/finance/financing): Licensed banks, finance companies, Islamic finance providers and, where permitted, institutional investors. T57 does not lend.
- [What do lenders see?](https://www.t57.ai/capabilities/finance/financing): Only the deal file you choose to share: your T57 Passport, the contract, counterparties, documents and trade history.
- [How does repayment work?](https://www.t57.ai/capabilities/finance/financing): In most structures, the end buyer's payment goes into escrow and repays the lender at settlement, before the balance is released to you.
- [How quickly can I receive offers?](https://www.t57.ai/capabilities/finance/supply-chain-finance): That depends on each lender's process. Because the deal file is already verified, lenders can respond faster than to a standard application.
- [Do I need collateral?](https://www.t57.ai/capabilities/finance/supply-chain-finance): Many structures rely on the trade itself, through confirmed orders, invoices and escrow repayment, rather than on property or other collateral. Each lender sets its own requirements.
- [Can large buyers offer finance to their suppliers?](https://www.t57.ai/capabilities/finance/supply-chain-finance): Yes. Through payables finance, an anchor buyer can let its verified suppliers be paid early by partner lenders.
- [Is this the same as crypto?](https://www.t57.ai/capabilities/finance/crowdfunding): No. A tokenized asset is a digital record of a real asset, such as an invoice or a cold store. It is not a currency.
- [Who can invest?](https://www.t57.ai/capabilities/finance/crowdfunding): Licensed lenders, and investors eligible under the rules of the licensed fundraising platform and their own country.
- [What happens if the trade fails?](https://www.t57.ai/capabilities/finance/crowdfunding): The outcome depends on the structure. Funders may have rights to the underlying asset, insurance or guarantees, which are set out before they commit.
- [Does T57 sell insurance?](https://www.t57.ai/capabilities/finance/risk-protection): T57 connects members to licensed insurers, takaful operators and brokers. Policies are issued by them, under their own regulation.
- [Can I use my existing insurer?](https://www.t57.ai/capabilities/finance/risk-protection): Yes. You can upload existing policies to the trade record so they can be used with LCs, lenders and claims.
- [What does compliance screening check?](https://www.t57.ai/capabilities/finance/risk-protection): Sanctions lists, watchlists, adverse media and beneficial ownership for every counterparty, before a deal moves forward.
- [Can I use my own freight forwarder?](https://www.t57.ai/capabilities/logistics): Yes. You can invite your forwarder to the trade record or upload its documents and tracking data.
- [Does T57 support cold-chain shipments?](https://www.t57.ai/capabilities/logistics): Yes. Cold-chain partners and temperature tracking are available for chilled and frozen goods.
- [Which modes of transport are covered?](https://www.t57.ai/capabilities/logistics): Sea, air and road freight, plus warehousing and cold storage, through vetted partners.
- [How are logistics partners vetted?](https://www.t57.ai/capabilities/logistics/network): Partners go through business verification, license and insurance checks, and their performance is rated on recorded shipments.
- [Can I invite my own forwarder?](https://www.t57.ai/capabilities/logistics/network): Yes. Your existing forwarder can join the trade record and quote alongside network partners.
- [Does T57 negotiate freight rates?](https://www.t57.ai/capabilities/logistics/network): T57 aggregates demand and shows comparable quotes, which helps members get competitive rates. Members choose and book.
- [Do I need special tracking devices?](https://www.t57.ai/capabilities/logistics/tracking): No. T57 uses carrier and port data for all shipments. IoT devices add live temperature and location for sensitive cargo.
- [Who can see my shipment?](https://www.t57.ai/capabilities/logistics/tracking): Only the parties to the trade and the partners you authorize, such as your lender or insurer.
- [Can tracking trigger payment?](https://www.t57.ai/capabilities/logistics/tracking): Yes. Agreed milestones, such as arrival or delivery confirmation, can release escrow payments automatically.
- [Does T57 file customs declarations?](https://www.t57.ai/capabilities/logistics/customs): No. Licensed customs brokers file declarations, using the documents prepared on T57.
- [Is pre-clearance available in every country?](https://www.t57.ai/capabilities/logistics/customs): Pre-clearance depends on each customs authority's procedures. Where it is not available, T57 still sends complete, checked documents to the broker before arrival.
- [Are AI-suggested HS codes final?](https://www.t57.ai/capabilities/logistics/customs): No. They are suggestions for a broker or member to confirm. The final classification is the declarant's responsibility.
- [Where does T57's data come from?](https://www.t57.ai/capabilities/intelligence): Public market and trade sources, licensed data partners, and anonymized, aggregated data from trades on T57.
- [Is my trade data shared with other members?](https://www.t57.ai/capabilities/intelligence): No. Individual trades are never shown. They contribute only to anonymized, aggregated statistics.
- [Is intelligence included in membership?](https://www.t57.ai/capabilities/intelligence): Core intelligence is included. Higher membership tiers include deeper data, credit reports and forecasts.
- [How is the T57 index calculated?](https://www.t57.ai/capabilities/intelligence/price-index): It combines public market data, licensed data partners and anonymized, aggregated prices from verified T57 trades, with methods that prevent any single member's price from being identified.
- [How often is it updated?](https://www.t57.ai/capabilities/intelligence/price-index): It updates as new market data arrives and as verified trades close on T57. Some lines update daily, others weekly, depending on trade volume.
- [Can non-members see the index?](https://www.t57.ai/capabilities/intelligence/price-index): A selection of index lines is public on the T57 website. Full detail, history and alerts are available to members.
- [Does the AI negotiate on my behalf?](https://www.t57.ai/capabilities/intelligence/ai-negotiations): No. It prepares and suggests. You decide what to offer, counter or accept, and nothing is sent without your confirmation.
- [Can the other side see the engine's suggestions to me?](https://www.t57.ai/capabilities/intelligence/ai-negotiations): No. Your briefs and suggestions are private to you.
- [What data does the engine use?](https://www.t57.ai/capabilities/intelligence/ai-negotiations): The T57 price index, anonymized and aggregated trade data, the counterparty's public T57 profile and track record, and your own costs and history if you choose to add them.
- [Can I list my equipment or drone for rent?](https://www.t57.ai/capabilities/agritech/equipment-rental): Yes. Verified members list equipment and services with prices, areas served and availability.
- [Do I need to know how to operate it?](https://www.t57.ai/capabilities/agritech/equipment-rental): No. Book it with a trained operator, or book the job alone, such as spraying 10 hectares.
- [Who is responsible if something breaks?](https://www.t57.ai/capabilities/agritech/equipment-rental): The rental terms, condition records and any insurance set out responsibility. Disputes are handled under those terms and the payment partner's rules.
- [What happens to owners with poor ratings?](https://www.t57.ai/capabilities/agritech/equipment-rental): Ratings come only from recorded jobs. Repeated upheld complaints lead to suspension and then removal from T57.
- [How are experts checked?](https://www.t57.ai/capabilities/hire-an-expert): Identity, qualifications and references are verified before an expert can take jobs.
- [What if the advice is wrong or the job is not done?](https://www.t57.ai/capabilities/hire-an-expert): You can raise a dispute before payment is released. Upheld complaints count against the expert, and repeated ones lead to removal.
- [Do experts recommend chemicals?](https://www.t57.ai/capabilities/hire-an-expert): Experts recommend only products approved in the client's country and record the dose they advise.
- [Can my company offer services?](https://www.t57.ai/capabilities/hire-an-expert): Yes. Firms join as service providers; individuals join as experts.
- [What does "AI-native" mean at T57?](https://www.t57.ai/ai-native): AI is built into every step of the trade, from matching and pricing to compliance and documents, rather than added as a separate tool.
- [Does AI make decisions about my business?](https://www.t57.ai/ai-native): AI makes suggestions and flags issues. People make decisions, and every adverse decision is reviewed by a person.
- [What data does T57's AI use?](https://www.t57.ai/ai-native): Verified trade records, public market, trade and climate data, licensed data from partners, and farmer knowledge recorded with consent. Individual members' data is never shared with other members.
- [Why small, local models?](https://www.t57.ai/ai-native): Food is global but hyper-local. Small models trained for a region, crop and value chain understand local conditions and languages better, cost less to run and are easier to test and explain.
- [Can suppliers pay to rank higher?](https://www.t57.ai/ai-native/trade-matchmaking): No. Ranking is based on fit, verification and track record, never on payment.
- [Why was a particular partner suggested?](https://www.t57.ai/ai-native/trade-matchmaking): Every suggestion shows its main reasons, such as product match, capacity, corridor experience and on-time performance.
- [Can both parties use the engine in the same deal?](https://www.t57.ai/ai-native/negotiations): Yes. Each party gets its own private brief based on the same public market data.
- [Which languages are supported?](https://www.t57.ai/ai-native/llm-orders): Arabic, English, Hindi, Malay and Turkish, with more added as T57 grows into new markets.
- [What happens if the AI is unsure?](https://www.t57.ai/ai-native/llm-orders): It asks a short question instead of guessing, and the order is not sent until you confirm.
- [How accurate are the AI estimates?](https://www.t57.ai/ai-native/price-index): Each price shows a confidence level. Accuracy is measured by comparing estimates with later verified trades, and results are published by product group.
- [Can the index be manipulated by fake trades?](https://www.t57.ai/ai-native/price-index): Only trades between verified members count, outliers are detected and down-weighted, and no single trade can move the index alone.
- [How far ahead do forecasts look?](https://www.t57.ai/ai-native/supply-demand-forecasting): From a few weeks to a season, depending on the product and the data available. Every forecast shows its range.
- [Can governments use the forecasts?](https://www.t57.ai/ai-native/supply-demand-forecasting): Yes. Governments and institutions can access aggregated supply status and forecasts through T57's food security view.
- [Can I see my own risk score?](https://www.t57.ai/ai-native/risk-intelligence): Yes. Members can see the scores that relate to them and the main reasons, and can ask for a review.
- [Who else can see risk heatmaps?](https://www.t57.ai/ai-native/risk-intelligence): Lenders and insurers see risk only for the trades you share with them. Governments see aggregated, anonymized views.
- [Do farmers need special equipment?](https://www.t57.ai/ai-native/crop-yield-forecasting): No. Forecasts use satellite and weather data. Farmers can add observations by voice or photo from a basic smartphone, or through their cooperative.
- [Who can see a farm's forecast?](https://www.t57.ai/ai-native/crop-yield-forecasting): The farmer or cooperative, and anyone they choose to share it with, such as a buyer or lender.
- [Is the prediction a guarantee?](https://www.t57.ai/ai-native/profit-loss-prediction): No. It shows the most likely outcome and a range, based on current data. Actual results depend on weather, markets and execution.
- [Can I add my own costs?](https://www.t57.ai/ai-native/profit-loss-prediction): Yes. Adding your own costs makes predictions more accurate, and your data stays private.
- [Does the AI tell me exactly what to plant?](https://www.t57.ai/ai-native/crop-planning): It recommends options with expected yields and margins. You decide, and you can adjust the plan at any time.
- [Can cooperatives plan for all their members?](https://www.t57.ai/ai-native/crop-planning): Yes. Cooperatives can build plans across members' farms to balance supply and meet buyer demand.
- [Which languages does the agronomy AI speak?](https://www.t57.ai/ai-native/agronomy-ai): Local languages in T57's markets, starting with Arabic, Hindi, Malay, Turkish and English and expanding to regional languages, including by voice.
- [Who are the agronomists?](https://www.t57.ai/ai-native/agronomy-ai): Verified agronomists and agricultural experts who join T57 as service providers. Their qualifications are checked before they can advise.
- [Can AI reject my application?](https://www.t57.ai/ai-native/ai-compliance): No. AI can flag issues, but only a person can make an adverse decision, and you can ask for a review.
- [How is my data protected?](https://www.t57.ai/ai-native/ai-compliance): Your data is used for verification and shared with partners only with your consent, under T57's privacy policy and applicable data protection laws.
- [Do I need to upload my own data?](https://www.t57.ai/ai-native/predictive-analytics): No. The dashboard is built from your activity on T57. You can add other data, such as costs, for better forecasts.
- [Can I share the dashboard with my lender?](https://www.t57.ai/ai-native/predictive-analytics): Yes. You can share selected views with lenders or investors, with your consent.
- [Are AI-generated contracts legally binding?](https://www.t57.ai/ai-native/ai-documentation): Contracts become binding when the parties sign them. T57 uses standard trade terms, and members can have their own lawyers review any document.
- [Which documents can be generated?](https://www.t57.ai/ai-native/ai-documentation): Contracts, pro forma and commercial invoices, packing lists, LC applications and supporting documents, and data for certificates and customs declarations.
- [Is T57 a marketplace or a platform?](https://www.t57.ai/platform): T57 is a platform: a members-only verified trade club with the infrastructure to run trades end to end. Members trade directly with each other on it.
- [Can T57 connect to my existing systems?](https://www.t57.ai/platform): Yes. T57 offers APIs for ERP, accounting and procurement systems, and connects to partner banks, insurers and logistics providers.
- [Where is my data stored?](https://www.t57.ai/platform): On Microsoft Azure cloud infrastructure across regions, designed to meet each market's data-residency requirements.
- [Does T57 charge listing fees or rebates?](https://www.t57.ai/platform/domestic-trade): No. There are no listing fees, slotting rebates or forced promotions. Sellers set their own prices. T57 membership options are on the Pricing page.
- [Who delivers the orders?](https://www.t57.ai/platform/domestic-trade): Licensed local logistics partners, booked from the order. Sellers can also invite the delivery company they already use.
- [Can buyers pay later?](https://www.t57.ai/platform/domestic-trade): Yes, where a licensed B2B credit or pay-later partner approves the buyer. T57 does not lend.
- [What is the minimum order?](https://www.t57.ai/platform/domestic-trade): Each seller sets it, for example 2, 5 or 20 cartons, with lower prices for larger orders.
- [Can farms and cooperatives sell this way?](https://www.t57.ai/platform/domestic-trade): Yes. Farms, cooperatives and food processors can list fresh and packed products for local business buyers.
- [Which countries is this for?](https://www.t57.ai/platform/domestic-trade): Domestic B2B trade is built for each of T57's founding markets: Saudi Arabia, the UAE, India, Malaysia and Türkiye.
- [Which cloud does T57 use?](https://www.t57.ai/platform/architecture): Microsoft Azure, across regions, designed to meet each market's data-residency requirements.
- [Does T57 offer APIs?](https://www.t57.ai/platform/architecture): Yes. Members and partners can integrate through REST APIs and webhooks. Documentation is available to approved members and partners.
- [Can partners keep their data in their own systems?](https://www.t57.ai/platform/architecture): Yes. Partners exchange only the data each trade needs, under agreement and with consent, and keep their own systems of record.
- [Can I join T57 now?](https://www.t57.ai/platform/roadmap): Yes. Membership applications are open, starting in the founding markets.
- [How do I find out when new capabilities reach my market?](https://www.t57.ai/platform/roadmap): Members are notified in the platform, and partners receive integration updates directly.
- [Can my organization help shape the roadmap?](https://www.t57.ai/platform/roadmap): Yes. Partners and institutional members can join pilot programs and advisory groups.
- [Does T57 use my data to train AI?](https://www.t57.ai/platform/intelligence-layer): T57 uses verified trade data in anonymized, aggregated form to improve its models. Your individual data is never shown to other members, and farmer knowledge is used only with consent.
- [Why not just use a large general AI model?](https://www.t57.ai/platform/intelligence-layer): Large models are useful for language and documents, and T57 uses them where they fit. For crops, markets and local conditions, small models trained on local data are more accurate, cheaper to run and easier to test and explain.
- [Can I challenge an AI decision?](https://www.t57.ai/platform/intelligence-layer): Yes. Every adverse decision comes with a reason and a route to contest it, and a person reviews it.
- [Is my trade data public on the blockchain?](https://www.t57.ai/platform/blockchain): No. Only digital fingerprints of key records are anchored. Document contents stay in secure storage, visible only to authorized parties.
- [Do I need cryptocurrency to use the blockchain layer?](https://www.t57.ai/platform/blockchain): No. The blockchain layer works in the background. Members pay and get paid in normal currencies through licensed partners, unless they choose alternative payments where lawful.
- [What happens if a milestone is disputed?](https://www.t57.ai/platform/blockchain): The smart contract pauses release, and the dispute is handled under the contract and the partner's rules.
- [Can other members see my prices or suppliers?](https://www.t57.ai/platform/security): No. Your commercial data is visible only to you and the parties in your trades, according to the permissions you set.
- [What happens if there is a security incident?](https://www.t57.ai/platform/security): T57 follows a defined incident response process, and affected members and authorities are notified as the law requires.
- [Is T57 an open marketplace?](https://www.t57.ai/trust): No. T57 is a members-only trade club. Every buyer and seller is verified before trading, and verification is renewed.
- [Does T57 hold my money?](https://www.t57.ai/trust): No. Payments, escrow and letters of credit are handled by licensed partners. T57 organizes the trade and records each step.
- [How do I know who I am trading with?](https://www.t57.ai/trust): Every member has a verified T57 Passport that shows their role, checks passed and trade history, shared with consent.
- [What happens if a trade goes wrong?](https://www.t57.ai/trust): T57 provides a structured dispute process based on the shared trade record, and escrow can pause release while a dispute is resolved.
- [How long does verification take?](https://www.t57.ai/trust/verification): It depends on the business and whether a site visit is needed. T57 tells you what is outstanding at each stage.
- [Why does T57 visit my farm or factory?](https://www.t57.ai/trust/verification): To confirm that businesses claiming to produce really do. This is what lets buyers trust the owner-producer label.
- [Do I need to verify again for each trade?](https://www.t57.ai/trust/verification): No. Your T57 Passport is reusable. It is renewed periodically, and you update it when your details change.
- [What if my application is declined?](https://www.t57.ai/trust/verification): You receive a stated reason and can ask for a review by a person.
- [What documents do I need for KYB?](https://www.t57.ai/trust/verification/kyb): Company registration, licenses, details of directors and owners, and bank information. The exact list depends on your country and role.
- [Who sees my KYB documents?](https://www.t57.ai/trust/verification/kyb): T57's verification team. Others see only your verified Passport, and only what you choose to share.
- [How often is KYB renewed?](https://www.t57.ai/trust/verification/kyb): Periodically, and whenever key details such as ownership or licenses change.
- [Can a cooperative pass KYB on behalf of its farmers?](https://www.t57.ai/trust/verification/kyb): Yes. A cooperative or producer organization is verified as a business, and its member producers are onboarded through it.
- [Who needs to complete KYC?](https://www.t57.ai/trust/verification/kyc): Owners, directors and anyone who will act for the company on T57.
- [Is my ID shared with other members?](https://www.t57.ai/trust/verification/kyc): No. Other members see that you are verified, not your documents.
- [What if I leave the company?](https://www.t57.ai/trust/verification/kyc): The company removes your access, and your past actions stay in the audit trail.
- [Can I use one identity for several companies?](https://www.t57.ai/trust/verification/kyc): Yes. Each company link is verified separately, with its own role and authority.
- [What affects my trust rating?](https://www.t57.ai/trust/verification/membership-scoring): Your verification, completed trades, on-time delivery, document accuracy, payment performance and feedback from your trading partners.
- [Can I see my own rating?](https://www.t57.ai/trust/verification/membership-scoring): Yes, with the main factors behind it.
- [Can I dispute a rating?](https://www.t57.ai/trust/verification/membership-scoring): Yes. You can contest any rating or feedback, and a person reviews it.
- [Do new members start at zero?](https://www.t57.ai/trust/verification/membership-scoring): New members start with a rating based on their verification, which grows as they trade.
- [Can anyone edit the audit trail?](https://www.t57.ai/trust/audit-trail): No. Entries are tamper-evident: any change can be detected, and nothing is deleted. Corrections are added as new entries.
- [Who can see my trade's audit trail?](https://www.t57.ai/trust/audit-trail): The parties to the trade, and anyone they choose to share it with, such as a lender or auditor.
- [How long are records kept?](https://www.t57.ai/trust/audit-trail): For the period required by law in each market.
- [Are AI decisions recorded?](https://www.t57.ai/trust/audit-trail): Yes. AI recommendations and the human decisions made on them are logged.
- [Which documents can T57 generate?](https://www.t57.ai/trust/document-management): Commercial documents such as invoices, packing lists and contract-based forms. Official certificates are issued by the relevant authority or partner and uploaded to the record.
- [Does T57 check my documents?](https://www.t57.ai/trust/document-management): AI checks for gaps and mismatches and flags them. Your team and your partners make the final decisions.
- [Who can see my documents?](https://www.t57.ai/trust/document-management): Only the parties you authorize for each trade.
- [Are original paper documents still needed?](https://www.t57.ai/trust/document-management): In some markets and for some documents, yes. T57 shows where paper originals are still required.
- [Does T57 sell my data?](https://www.t57.ai/trust/security): No. T57 does not sell members' individual data. Market insights use aggregated, anonymized data.
- [Can T57 staff see my data?](https://www.t57.ai/trust/security): Only staff who need it for verification, support or compliance, under strict access controls, and access is logged.
- [Can I delete my data?](https://www.t57.ai/trust/security): You can ask for deletion, subject to records the law requires T57 or its partners to keep.
- [How do I report a security concern?](https://www.t57.ai/trust/security): Contact our security team at hello@t57.ai.
- [How do I access or correct my data?](https://www.t57.ai/trust/security/data-protection): Through your account settings, or by contacting our data protection team.
- [Does T57 share my data with partners?](https://www.t57.ai/trust/security/data-protection): Only with your consent, or where a trade or the law requires it, such as sharing documents with a partner bank you chose.
- [Who is responsible for data protection at T57?](https://www.t57.ai/trust/security/data-protection): T57's data protection lead, who can be reached at hello@t57.ai.
- [What disputes does T57 cover?](https://www.t57.ai/trust/trade-assurance/disputes): Disputes over trades made on T57, such as quality, quantity, delivery, documents and payment.
- [Does T57 decide who is right?](https://www.t57.ai/trust/trade-assurance/disputes): T57 helps the parties reach an agreement based on the record and their contract. Where they cannot agree, the dispute follows the route set in the contract.
- [What happens to my money during a dispute?](https://www.t57.ai/trust/trade-assurance/disputes): If the trade uses escrow, the disputed amount is held by the licensed escrow partner until the dispute is resolved.
- [Does a dispute affect my trust rating?](https://www.t57.ai/trust/trade-assurance/disputes): The outcome is recorded. A fair resolution does not count against either side, and you can contest any rating effect.
- [Which countries does T57 operate in?](https://www.t57.ai/markets): Saudi Arabia, the UAE, India, Malaysia and Türkiye. More markets will follow.
- [Can I trade with a country that is not a T57 market?](https://www.t57.ai/markets): Members in founding markets can buy from or sell to verified members in other founding markets.
- [Does T57 support domestic trade, or only exports?](https://www.t57.ai/markets): Both. Domestic B2B trade and cross-border trade run on the same platform.
- [Is T57 only for the five founding markets?](https://www.t57.ai/markets/global-rollout): No. The five founding markets have country teams on the ground, but T57 is open online to verified businesses in 195 countries, and new markets open phase by phase.
- [Can I join if my country is not a T57 market yet?](https://www.t57.ai/markets/global-rollout): Yes. Apply online and complete digital KYB and KYC checks and compliance screening. Some local services, such as delivery or pay-later terms, depend on partner coverage in your country.
- [What changes when T57 opens a market?](https://www.t57.ai/markets/global-rollout): A local team or country partner, local-language support, local logistics, inspection and finance partners, and a guide to that country's food rules.
- [How does T57 choose the next markets?](https://www.t57.ai/markets/global-rollout): By trade corridors with real supply and demand, the readiness of local partners, legal opinions and demand from members. A phase opens only when these are in place.
- [Are the dates fixed?](https://www.t57.ai/markets/global-rollout): No. They are targets from T57's rollout plan, and each phase opens when it is ready.
- [What is a T57 country partner?](https://www.t57.ai/markets/global-rollout): A licensed local business that runs T57 in its country or city, like a franchise. See the Country Partner page to apply.
- [Does T57 issue halal certificates?](https://www.t57.ai/markets/oic-halal): No. Halal certificates are issued by accredited halal bodies. T57 records them, tracks expiry and shows them to buyers.
- [Which OIC countries can use T57?](https://www.t57.ai/markets/oic-halal): T57's founding markets include Saudi Arabia, the UAE, Malaysia and Türkiye, all OIC members, and India, a major supplier to OIC markets. More OIC countries will follow.
- [Is Islamic trade finance available?](https://www.t57.ai/markets/oic-halal): T57 connects members with licensed partners, including those offering Shariah-compliant finance where available.
- [Which ASEAN countries can use T57?](https://www.t57.ai/markets/asean): Malaysia is a founding market. Other ASEAN countries will follow.
- [Can ASEAN producers sell within ASEAN?](https://www.t57.ai/markets/asean): Yes. Domestic wholesale is available in Malaysia, and cross-border trade grows as more ASEAN markets join.
- [How does T57 relate to DEFA?](https://www.t57.ai/markets/asean): T57 is an independent platform. Its digital records and consent-based data sharing are designed to fit regional digital trade rules such as DEFA, once in force.
- [Who can join T57 in Saudi Arabia?](https://www.t57.ai/markets/saudi-arabia/overview): Registered food and agriculture businesses, from producers and cooperatives to traders, wholesalers, retailers, hotels, restaurants and institutions.
- [Do I need to export to use T57?](https://www.t57.ai/markets/saudi-arabia/overview): No. Many members use T57 for domestic wholesale only.
- [Is T57 available in Arabic?](https://www.t57.ai/markets/saudi-arabia/overview): Yes.
- [Are all features available in every market?](https://www.t57.ai/markets/saudi-arabia/features): Yes. The partners that deliver regulated services differ by country.
- [Can I pay in SAR?](https://www.t57.ai/markets/saudi-arabia/features): Yes, through licensed payment and escrow partners.
- [Who provides finance in Saudi Arabia?](https://www.t57.ai/markets/saudi-arabia/features): Licensed Saudi banks and finance companies. T57 does not lend.
- [Is this guide legal advice?](https://www.t57.ai/markets/saudi-arabia/compliance): No. It is a summary to help you prepare. Always confirm requirements with the relevant authority or your customs broker.
- [How often is the guide updated?](https://www.t57.ai/markets/saudi-arabia/compliance): T57 reviews it regularly.
- [Can T57 handle customs clearance for me?](https://www.t57.ai/markets/saudi-arabia/compliance): T57 connects you with licensed customs brokers, who handle clearance on the shared trade record.
- [How long until I can trade?](https://www.t57.ai/markets/saudi-arabia/getting-started): Once verification is complete.
- [Is there a cost to join?](https://www.t57.ai/markets/saudi-arabia/getting-started): See Pricing for membership options.
- [Can someone help me in Arabic?](https://www.t57.ai/markets/saudi-arabia/getting-started): Yes. Our Riyadh team supports members in Arabic and English.
- [Can free zone companies join?](https://www.t57.ai/markets/uae/overview): Yes. Mainland and free zone companies can apply, subject to verification.
- [Can I pay in AED?](https://www.t57.ai/markets/uae/features): Yes, through licensed payment and escrow partners.
- [Who provides finance in the UAE?](https://www.t57.ai/markets/uae/features): Licensed UAE banks and finance companies. T57 does not lend.
- [Can a farmer producer organization join?](https://www.t57.ai/markets/india/overview): Yes. FPOs and cooperatives can join as members and onboard their member farmers.
- [Is T57 only for exporters?](https://www.t57.ai/markets/india/overview): No. Many members use T57 to sell to domestic business buyers.
- [Can I pay in INR?](https://www.t57.ai/markets/india/features): Yes, through licensed payment and escrow partners.
- [Who provides finance in India?](https://www.t57.ai/markets/india/features): Licensed Indian banks and NBFCs. T57 does not lend.
- [Can someone help me in Hindi?](https://www.t57.ai/markets/india/getting-started): Yes. Our India team supports members in English and Hindi.
- [Does T57 recognize JAKIM certification?](https://www.t57.ai/markets/malaysia/overview): T57 records halal certificates from JAKIM and other bodies, and shows buyers whether a certificate is recognized in their market.
- [Is T57 available in Malay?](https://www.t57.ai/markets/malaysia/overview): English and Malay.
- [Can I pay in MYR?](https://www.t57.ai/markets/malaysia/features): Yes, through licensed payment and escrow partners.
- [Who provides finance in Malaysia?](https://www.t57.ai/markets/malaysia/features): Licensed Malaysian banks, including Islamic banks. T57 does not lend.
- [Can someone help me in Malay?](https://www.t57.ai/markets/malaysia/getting-started): Yes. Our Malaysia team supports members in English and Malay.
- [Can Turkish companies trade in USD or EUR?](https://www.t57.ai/markets/turkiye/overview): Yes, through licensed payment and escrow partners, in any currency they support.
- [Is halal certification needed for Gulf exports?](https://www.t57.ai/markets/turkiye/overview): For some products, yes. T57 shows the requirements for each product and destination.
- [Is T57 available in Turkish?](https://www.t57.ai/markets/turkiye/overview): English and Turkish.
- [Can I pay in TRY?](https://www.t57.ai/markets/turkiye/features): Yes, through licensed payment and escrow partners.
- [Who provides finance in Türkiye?](https://www.t57.ai/markets/turkiye/features): Licensed Turkish banks, including participation banks. T57 does not lend.
- [Can someone help me in Turkish?](https://www.t57.ai/markets/turkiye/getting-started): Yes. Our Türkiye team supports members in English and Turkish.
- [Do I pay to list products or send quotes?](https://www.t57.ai/pricing): No. Listing, quoting and negotiating are included in your membership. The trade fee applies only when a trade is completed.
- [Does T57 earn anything from finance or insurance?](https://www.t57.ai/pricing): Yes. T57 earns a small commission from some finance and insurance partners. It is disclosed before you accept a partner's offer.
- [Are prices the same in every country?](https://www.t57.ai/pricing): The prices shown are standard list prices in US dollars. Local prices may be lower in markets with lower purchasing power. Contact us for pricing in your country.
- [Is there a free trial?](https://www.t57.ai/pricing): Yes. Founding members get 90 days free at launch. The trial lets you explore the network and tools. Trading starts once you subscribe and are verified.
- [Which plan should I choose?](https://www.t57.ai/pricing/plans): If you trade occasionally, start with Explore. As a rough guide, the trade fee savings on a higher plan pay for its higher membership once your monthly trade volume is large enough. The ROI calculator shows the break-even for your business.
- [What does the free trial include?](https://www.t57.ai/pricing/plans): You can build your profile, explore verified members and market intelligence, use AI tools and send requests for quote. Verification, contracts, escrow and finance start when you subscribe, because verification involves real checks by our team and partners. Founding members get 90 days free at launch.
- [Can I switch plans?](https://www.t57.ai/pricing/plans): Yes. You can move up at any time, and move down at renewal.
- [Can T57 integrate with our ERP?](https://www.t57.ai/pricing/enterprise): Yes, through APIs. Our team scopes the integration with you.
- [Can we keep our existing suppliers?](https://www.t57.ai/pricing/enterprise): Yes. Invite them to T57, and they are verified like every other member.
- [How is government pricing set?](https://www.t57.ai/pricing/government): By program, based on scope, number of members, markets and modules. Contact our institutional team for a proposal.
- [Can a ministry pay for its farmers' memberships?](https://www.t57.ai/pricing/government): Yes. Governments and development partners can fund memberships and onboarding for farmers, cooperatives and SMEs.
- [Can foreign suppliers respond to our tenders?](https://www.t57.ai/pricing/government): Yes, if you open a tender to them. Every supplier is verified before it can bid.
- [Is the result a quote?](https://www.t57.ai/pricing/roi-calculator): No. It is an estimate based on your inputs and standard prices. Local prices may be lower in your market.
- [Do you keep my data?](https://www.t57.ai/pricing/roi-calculator): Only if you choose to save or share your result.
- [Are T57 resources free?](https://www.t57.ai/resources): Most are free. Some in-depth reports may ask for your email.
- [Can I suggest a topic?](https://www.t57.ai/resources): Yes. Contact our team with the topic you would like us to cover.
- [Are resources available in other languages?](https://www.t57.ai/resources): Key resources will be available in Arabic and other languages of our founding markets.
- [How often do you publish?](https://www.t57.ai/resources/blog): Several times a month. T57 Insights has published 25 articles since December 2025.
- [Who writes T57 Insights?](https://www.t57.ai/resources/blog): T57’s founders and leadership team: Afzal Hussain Mohammed Nakheeb, Abdul Bari Kareem, Umme Habeeba Khanum, Mohammed Umair and Dr. Moaz Abdullah Mohammed Mojaddidi.
- [Can I write for T57?](https://www.t57.ai/resources/blog): Partners and experts can contact our team with a proposal.
- [Are reports free?](https://www.t57.ai/resources/reports): Yes. Some may ask for your email.
- [Can institutions commission research?](https://www.t57.ai/resources/reports): Yes, contact our team.
- [Are webinars recorded?](https://www.t57.ai/resources/events): Yes, recordings are posted here.
- [Can I book a meeting at an event?](https://www.t57.ai/resources/events): Yes, through the event page.
- [Is T57 a marketplace?](https://www.t57.ai/resources/faq-glossary): No. On an open marketplace, anyone can list. On T57, every member is verified before they trade, and their role is checked and shown.
- [Does T57 buy or sell food?](https://www.t57.ai/resources/faq-glossary): No. T57 does not own goods, lend money, hold client funds or provide transport. Members trade with each other, and licensed partners provide regulated services.
- [Is support included in my plan?](https://www.t57.ai/help): Yes. Every plan includes the help center and email support, and higher plans add live chat, priority support and a dedicated account manager.
- [What languages is support available in?](https://www.t57.ai/help): English, Arabic and the main languages of our founding markets.
- [How long does the free trial last?](https://www.t57.ai/help/faq): Founding members get 90 days free at launch. After the launch period, the trial is 14 days.
- [Can I trade during the free trial?](https://www.t57.ai/help/faq): You can explore members, intelligence and AI tools, and send requests for quote. Contracts, escrow and finance start once you subscribe and are verified.
- [How do I cancel or change my plan?](https://www.t57.ai/help/faq): From your account settings. Upgrades apply at once, and downgrades apply at renewal.
- [Can other members see my prices?](https://www.t57.ai/help/faq): No. Only the parties you quote can see your prices.
- [Does T57 compete with partners?](https://www.t57.ai/partnerships): No. T57 does not lend, insure, ship or inspect. It brings partners verified customers and better data.
- [How do partners get paid?](https://www.t57.ai/partnerships): Members pay partners for their services directly. T57 may earn a small commission from some partners, as agreed in each partnership.
- [Can partners in any country join?](https://www.t57.ai/partnerships): Partners licensed in T57's markets, or serving trade with them, can apply.
- [Do you offer APIs?](https://www.t57.ai/partners/technology): Yes, for approved partners.
- [Can a SaaS company offer T57 to its customers?](https://www.t57.ai/partners/technology): Yes, through partner and white-label options.
- [Does T57 take credit risk?](https://www.t57.ai/partners/financial-services): No. Partners make their own credit decisions.
- [Can Islamic banks and takaful operators join?](https://www.t57.ai/partners/financial-services): Yes.
- [Do members choose their own logistics partner?](https://www.t57.ai/partners/logistics): Yes. They can choose from T57's partners or bring their own.
- [Can inspection results trigger payment?](https://www.t57.ai/partners/logistics): Yes, when the parties agree it in their contract.
- [Who owns the research and data?](https://www.t57.ai/partners/research): The partner institution. T57 uses research and data only under the terms agreed with each partner, and credits the source.
- [How are scientists paid?](https://www.t57.ai/partners/research): Through license fees and royalties agreed up front, and through paid advice on Hire an Expert.
- [Can start-ups from a university join?](https://www.t57.ai/partners/research): Yes. Start-ups can list their technology for rent or sale, and offer services, to T57 members.
- [Which institutions can apply?](https://www.t57.ai/partners/research): Agricultural universities, research institutes, academies and their start-ups, in any country.
- [Is this a franchise?](https://www.t57.ai/partners/country-partner): It works like one. You run T57 in an agreed territory under licence, with the T57 brand, platform and support, and share in the revenue from the members you bring.
- [Which countries are open to partners?](https://www.t57.ai/partners/country-partner): Countries and cities where T57 has no country team yet. See the Global Rollout page for the phases.
- [Can I cover just one city?](https://www.t57.ai/partners/country-partner): Yes. Territories can be a whole country, a region or a trading city.
- [Do partners handle money or goods?](https://www.t57.ai/partners/country-partner): No. Members pay through licensed payment and escrow partners, and goods move with logistics partners. Partners do not lend.
- [Is there a fee to become a partner?](https://www.t57.ai/partners/country-partner): Terms are agreed with each partner and set out in the partner license.
- [Where is T57 based?](https://www.t57.ai/about): T57 is a global SaaS platform, so any food business, anywhere in the world, can apply online, get verified and trade. The pilot starts in five countries: Saudi Arabia, the UAE, India, Malaysia and Türkiye.
- [What does the name T57 mean?](https://www.t57.ai/about): T stands for trade, built on trust, transparency and traceability. The 5 stands for the five industries T57 connects: agriculture and food production, trade, logistics, finance and technology. The 7 stands for the seven outcomes we work toward: food security, less food lost, integration, access to finance, higher incomes, inclusion and resilience.
- [Who owns T57?](https://www.t57.ai/about): T57 is founder-led.
- [Who has T57 signed agreements with?](https://www.t57.ai/about/journey): T57 and its founding company, AlMukarramah, have agreements with the Islamic Organization for Food Security (IOFS), the Government of the Chechen Republic, the Development Bank of Maldives, Food Contract Corporation of Kazakhstan, the International Assembly of Islamic Business, Dar Al Halal Nigeria and the Aquaculture Centre of Excellence in Singapore, and signed 120 MoUs and letters of intent at Gulfood 2026.
- [When did T57 start?](https://www.t57.ai/about/journey): T57 was introduced at the Food Security Conference in Cape Town in August 2023 and pre-launched at the 2nd IOFS Food Security Forum in Doha in October 2023. It grew out of Trade57, built by AlMukarramah.
- [Are the MoUs binding?](https://www.t57.ai/about/journey): Most are memoranda of understanding and letters of intent: frameworks for working together. Any subscription or commercial commitment is made in a separate agreement.
- [Who leads T57?](https://www.t57.ai/about/leadership): T57 is led by its Founder and Chairman, Afzal Hussain Mohammed Nakheeb, with four co-founders who lead technology, product, communication and governance.
- [How does T57 work with IOFS?](https://www.t57.ai/about/leadership): T57 has a 10-year MoU with IOFS. Its Director General, Strategic Relations, Prof. Yerlan Baidaulet, is the former Director-General of IOFS.
- [Is T57 a government system?](https://www.t57.ai/about/food-security): No. T57 is an independent platform that governments and institutions can use, with permissioned data.
- [What data does a government see?](https://www.t57.ai/about/food-security): Aggregated, permissioned data on supply, prices and trade, never individual members' data without consent.
- [Does T57 work only for Muslim-majority countries?](https://www.t57.ai/about/food-security): No. T57 serves any food business or government in its markets, and works closely with IOFS and the OIC.
- [Can T57 report impact for our program?](https://www.t57.ai/about/sdg-delivery): Yes. Partners agree the indicators, and T57 reports aggregated, permissioned data.
- [Does T57 claim to deliver the SDGs on its own?](https://www.t57.ai/about/sdg-delivery): No. T57 contributes to specific targets alongside governments, development partners and the private sector.
- [Can I apply if no role fits?](https://www.t57.ai/about/careers): Yes. Send your CV to hr@t57.ai and tell us which team you want to join.
- [Do you hire remotely?](https://www.t57.ai/about/careers): Some technology roles can be remote, and country teams work in each market.
- [How quickly will you reply?](https://www.t57.ai/contact): Within two working days.
- [Can I contact you in Arabic?](https://www.t57.ai/contact): Yes.
- [Where are you based?](https://www.t57.ai/contact): Online, everywhere. T57 is a global SaaS platform that any food business can join from any country. The pilot starts in Saudi Arabia, the UAE, India, Malaysia and Türkiye.
- [Is the demo free?](https://www.t57.ai/contact/demo): Yes.
- [Can my team join?](https://www.t57.ai/contact/demo): Yes, invite as many colleagues as you like.
- [Do I need to visit an office?](https://www.t57.ai/contact/offices): No. T57 is a global SaaS platform, so you apply, get verified and trade online. To meet the team, email hello@t57.ai.
- [Who supports my country?](https://www.t57.ai/contact/offices): In the five pilot markets, the local team. Anywhere else, our global team, by chat or at hello@t57.ai.
- [How does T57 support national and regional food-security strategies in practice?](https://www.t57.ai/who-we-serve/governments): Many countries are now expanding strategic reserves and silo capacity to hold months’ worth of essential commodities. T57 complements such physical infrastructure by tracking self-sufficiency, stock levels, and import exposure in real time. This combination of physical reserves and digital intelligence helps governments move from reactive to anticipatory food-security management.
- [Why is it important to channel private and impact capital into agriculture and food systems, beyond public budgets?](https://www.t57.ai/who-we-serve/governments): Despite agriculture’s historical role in employment and food security, global investors are only now seeking credible, measurable pathways to support food systems as part of their climate and SDG commitments. T57 helps governments present investable, data-backed opportunities, from model support centers to special agri zones and CSR programs, with transparent performance and impact tracking that meets both regulatory and investor expectations.
- [How does T57 handle disputes and reduce risks for financiers and investors?](https://www.t57.ai/who-we-serve/financiers): T57 reduces risk through its curated club membership model, which ensures vetted, credible counterparties in a high-trust environment. Its virtual trade desk supports execution, manages disputes, oversees documentation, and ensures consistent transaction follow-through for greater investor confidence.
- [Why is food and agri finance an important opportunity for investors now?](https://www.t57.ai/who-we-serve/financiers): Global food import demand remains enormous: FAO puts the global food import bill at $2.22 trillion in 2025, which underlines the scale and persistence of trade-linked financing needs in food markets.
- [Is trade finance generally considered a lower risk than other forms of credit exposure?](https://www.t57.ai/who-we-serve/financiers): Yes. The ICC Trade Register highlights that trade, supply chain, and export finance products continue to exhibit low-risk profiles and resilient default performance across challenging market conditions.
- [Why do financiers need stronger diligence and monitoring tools in agri markets?](https://www.t57.ai/who-we-serve/financiers): Food and agri transactions often involve fragmented supply chains, cross-border counterparties, and climate or logistics volatility, which makes visibility and verification especially valuable. The International Fund for Agricultural Development (IFAD) notes that small-scale producers remain underserved by finance, highlighting that large financing needs go unmet because risk gaps discourage capital.
- [How does T57's virtual trade desk help in disputes and risk management?](https://www.t57.ai/who-we-serve/sellers): The virtual trade desk helps manage risk. In a dispute, it mediates under the agreed terms and T57's dispute process. If a buyer defaults, T57 can help find another verified buyer for the goods, and any recovery runs through licensed partners.
- [How does a platform help with the financing gap?](https://www.t57.ai/who-we-serve/sellers): Dedicated trade platforms that provide rich transaction and compliance data can lower perceived risk for financiers, improving access to credit and reducing the cost of capital. T57 is designed to expose this data in an auditable way so that funders can underwrite your deals with greater confidence.
- [Why is documentation and certification such a big issue in food exports?](https://www.t57.ai/who-we-serve/sellers): Food exports are subject to stringent import-country inspection and certification regimes. Incomplete or incorrect certification can lead to rejection or non-compliance at the border. A system that centralizes documents, links them to lots and shipments, and validates certifications reduces the risk of costly rejections and delays.
- [Can better intelligence really help in volatile export markets?](https://www.t57.ai/who-we-serve/sellers): Agricultural prices remain exposed to extreme weather, changing biofuel policies and rising trade barriers. Exporters using structured market, crop and price intelligence are better able to adjust sourcing and pricing to protect margins.
- [Can intermediaries join T57?](https://www.t57.ai/who-we-serve/traders): Yes. Traders and intermediaries are welcome. They are labeled by role so every counterparty knows how the trade is structured.
- [Does T57 lend to traders?](https://www.t57.ai/who-we-serve/traders): No. T57 does not lend. It sends your deal file to licensed lenders, who decide whether to fund the trade and on what terms.
- [How do back-to-back contracts work on T57?](https://www.t57.ai/who-we-serve/traders): The supplier's accepted quote and the buyer's accepted order each generate a contract, and both sit on the same trade record so terms stay consistent.
- [What does a track record show?](https://www.t57.ai/who-we-serve/traders): Your completed trades, verification status and role, so new counterparties and lenders can see your history before they deal with you.
- [How does T57 verify suppliers?](https://www.t57.ai/who-we-serve/buyers): T57 runs business and identity checks, compliance screening and, where needed, a physical check of the supplier's premises. Each verified supplier receives a T57 Passport and a role label.
- [Can I buy only from producers?](https://www.t57.ai/who-we-serve/buyers): Yes. Role labels show whether a supplier is an owner-producer, processor, trader or intermediary, so you can filter for producers.
- [Does T57 hold my payment?](https://www.t57.ai/who-we-serve/buyers): No. T57 does not hold client funds. Escrow and letters of credit are provided by licensed partners.
- [Can I buy locally as well as import?](https://www.t57.ai/who-we-serve/buyers): Yes. T57 supports domestic wholesale for supermarkets, HoReCa and institutions as well as cross-border trade. See domestic B2B trade .
- [Why do manufacturers and enterprises need a digital trade workflow now?](https://www.t57.ai/who-we-serve/enterprises): Digital trade workflow is important for countering high losses, volatility, and operational friction in the industry. FAO reports 13.3% food loss before retail, while the World Bank points to ongoing food inflation and uneven commodity movement across markets.
- [How does T57 help reduce procurement risk?](https://www.t57.ai/who-we-serve/enterprises): T57 helps structure RFQs, centralize bid visibility, and support trade in a more verified counterparty environment. In volatile markets, faster sourcing decisions and improved documentation can help protect supply continuity and margins.
- [Why is settlement speed so important in food and agri trade?](https://www.t57.ai/who-we-serve/enterprises): Delayed settlement can slow shipments, tie up working capital, and undermine confidence in the trade relationship. Digital platforms that accelerate settlement improve market access and business efficiency.
- [Can T57 support governance, audit readiness, and compliance?](https://www.t57.ai/who-we-serve/enterprises): Yes. T57 is designed to connect documents, milestones, counterparties, and payment records within a single, trackable workflow. This makes it easier for enterprise teams to support internal controls, reviews, and audit requirements across complex trade operations.
- [Why is digitizing trade especially important for food processors?](https://www.t57.ai/who-we-serve/food-processors): Processors depend on timely and predictable raw material supplies and operate on tight margins. Supply assurance and trade execution platforms make inputs more predictable, optimize capacity utilization, and protect margins in volatile markets.
- [Does T57 help with working capital and financing challenges?](https://www.t57.ai/who-we-serve/food-processors): Partner banks, escrow structures, faster eLC workflows, and tokenized-trade capabilities are designed to shorten settlement cycles and connect real trade to innovative finance solutions. For processors, that can mean less cash stuck in transit and more capacity to invest in inventory, maintenance, or growth.
- [How does T57 help reduce supply and loss-related risks?](https://www.t57.ai/who-we-serve/food-processors): T57 supports more reliable sourcing by structuring RFQs, working with vetted counterparties, and creating better visibility across deals.
- [Can T57 support compliance and audit requirements for processing plants?](https://www.t57.ai/who-we-serve/food-processors): Yes. T57 keeps trade, payment, and documentation data linked within a single audit trail, supporting internal controls and external audits. This helps processors meet the documentation demands of regulators and financial compliance frameworks.
- [Why do cooperatives & FPOs need digital platforms like T57?](https://www.t57.ai/who-we-serve/cooperatives): Scale alone is not enough. Cooperatives and FPOs need systems that professionalize operations, improve market access, and strengthen bargaining power. When properly supported and organized by platforms like T57, agricultural cooperatives play a critical role in sustainable agrifood systems and food security.
- [How do members gain when their cooperative or FPO wins government tenders or a contract farming agreement?](https://www.t57.ai/who-we-serve/cooperatives): Government tenders and contract farming agreements lock in demand and timelines, so members know what to produce, when it will be picked up, and at what terms, which leads to more consistent prices and lower post-harvest losses. T57 helps members plan volumes and crop mix, match supply to tender requirements, coordinate logistics and documentation, and track fulfillment and payments in one place, turning tender wins and contracts into a distributed benefit for individual farmers.
- [How do T57 partners help me reach better markets?](https://www.t57.ai/who-we-serve/collaborators): T57's vetted partners help you meet standards, reliably move produce, and access premium capabilities to help you grow, without having to build these relationships yourself.
- [What kind of partners can I access on T57?](https://www.t57.ai/who-we-serve/collaborators): You can connect with a diverse range of partners who help you meet complex compliance requirements, reduce logistics losses, unlock financing and insurance, accelerate innovation, and turn more of your effort into predictable, higher-value trade outcomes.
- [How does T57 ensure that collaborators are trustworthy?](https://www.t57.ai/who-we-serve/collaborators): T57 uses a club-style model that includes due diligence, track-record checks, and ongoing performance data, ensuring that ecosystem participants work only with verified partners.
- [Why should governments and regulators care about the T57 partner network?](https://www.t57.ai/who-we-serve/collaborators): By providing access to trusted partners across the value chain, T57 helps users align their goals with the policy and regulatory boundaries established by governments.
- [How is T57 different from a simple marketplace?](https://www.t57.ai/who-we-serve/service-providers): T57 is built on verified participants, trade-linked workflows, and governed execution, not just listings and introductions.
- [Can I offer services across borders without a local office?](https://www.t57.ai/who-we-serve/service-providers): Yes. T57 is designed to help providers engage digitally across regions while reducing friction in discovery, contracting, and payment processes.
- [How does T57 help me build trust with clients?](https://www.t57.ai/who-we-serve/service-providers): Verified profiles, service histories, ratings, and performance records help buyers assess credibility before engaging.
- [Why are service providers becoming more important in the food trade?](https://www.t57.ai/who-we-serve/service-providers): Buyers and regulators increasingly expect traceability, food safety, reliable documentation, and faster issue resolution throughout supply chains. This makes service providers an important part of the supply chain.
- [Why should a farmer or producer use a digital trade platform like T57?](https://www.t57.ai/who-we-serve/farmers): T57 provides access to verified buyers and transparent payment processes. This reduces uncertainty and improves income realization.
- [What should farmers watch out for in contract farming?](https://www.t57.ai/who-we-serve/farmers): Contract farming deals are often between stronger buyers and weaker farmers. This could result in unfair terms, over-dependence on a single buyer, or disputes over quality and deductions. Farmers can access T57's expertise to negotiate the best terms.
- [Can better market access really reduce waste?](https://www.t57.ai/who-we-serve/farmers): Yes. Better matching of supply with demand, along with more coordinated trade execution, can reduce losses between harvest and market.
- [Why is finance such a major issue for producers?](https://www.t57.ai/who-we-serve/farmers): The World Bank notes that agriculture finance remains disproportionately limited in many developing markets due to risk, transaction costs, and the difficulty of serving fragmented rural borrowers. That is why trade-linked and digitally enabled finance models matter for producers who need working capital tied to real orders.
- [Does price intelligence really matter at the farm level?](https://www.t57.ai/who-we-serve/farmers): Yes. When producers lack visibility into demand and prices, they negotiate from a weaker position and often rely too heavily on intermediaries. T57's core model directly addresses this by improving access to market and price intelligence.
